# 90. Schema reference: every type

The document schema (`engine/schema/motion-1.json`, generated from the engine's `rexx-doc` types) has one root object and the types below. Each type's fields are in the `92-schema-types-*.md` pages (chunked alphabetically); every animatable property path is in `91-animatable-paths.md`. Unknown fields are rejected everywhere (`doc.unknown_field`) except `meta` and `x-*` keys.

## The root object

A rexx motion document in authored form (docs/spec/01-document.md). Canonical form is the subset without sugar.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `motion` | integer (≥ 0) | yes | Spec major version. `1`. |
| `meta` | object \| null | no | Free-form; never affects rendering. |
| `theme` | `Theme` \| null | no | Theme (spec 12 §12.1). Authored only. |
| `data` | any | no | Arbitrary JSON (spec 12 §12.2). Authored only. |
| `assets` | object \| null | no | Named external files. |
| `components` | object \| null | no | Local component definitions. Authored only. |
| `presets` | object \| null | no | Local presets. Authored only. |
| `comps` | object | no | At least one composition. |
| `main` | `Id` \| null | no | The root comp. Default `"main"` or the only comp. |
| `variants` | object \| null | no | Other sizes of the root comp. Authored only. |
| `output` | `Output` \| null | no | Default render settings. |
| `lint` | `LintConfig` \| null | no | Lint configuration. |
| `sims` | map string → `SimBake` \| null | no | Physics bakes. Canonical only. |

Unknown fields are rejected (`doc.unknown_field`).
